crossRefs.note: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

translations.web: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
translations.bsb: He led out His people like sheep and guided them like a flock in the wilderness.
translations.kjv: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
translations.asv: But he led forth his own people like sheep, And guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
